description: I live a full and expansive life. #selflove #confidence #selfmastery #dreamlife
transcript: I do not fear being perceived. I fear living a miserable life because I'm waiting for others to validate my life's experience. I refuse to minimize myself. I live a life without restrictions. I live a life based on little tiny steps that I take in order to create a bigger picture. If I hear a song that I like, I am going to dance to it. I see someone that I know and love. I am going to make sure that they know that they are loved and valued by me. I do not live a small life. The fear of perception does not stop me.
